method: Documented Sundowner truth sets joined to ERA5 hourly reanalysis for a standard afternoon-to-morning event window. Includes peer-reviewed/historical cases plus the complete 2022 SWEX IOP set. Reanalysis features support analog/context analysis; documented station outcomes remain preferred and fire association is never a meteorological predictor.
